about_the_game:
Every gunslinger has heard of Uncle Gabe. Some say he was a shrewd trader who always had a fair deal… for those who could wait. Others claim he was a master craftsman, though he was known for never making three of anything. Whether that was a strange superstition or a joke only he understood, the rarity of his treasures speaks for itself.

Equipping this one-of-a-kind ring grants you protection from all damage-over-time effects—poison, bleeding, and burning. Whether you’re facing ruthless outlaws or feral beasts, it turns the tide in the fights that matter most.

From the dusty trails to the wild frontier, wear the signet and walk away from battles others wouldn’t live to tell about.

KEY FEATURES:

- Full damage over time immunity
